title: Transcriptomic atlas reveals organ-specific disease tolerance in sickle cell mice
author: Grunenwald, Anne
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Genotype and select mice
steps.instruction: Genotype all Townes model mice, then choose age‑ and sex‑matched HbAA and HbSS littermates aged 6–8 weeks for experiments.

steps.title: Anesthetize mice for procedures
steps.instruction: Induce anesthesia with isoflurane at 2–3% concentration for all subsequent injections, blood collection, and sacrifice.

steps.title: Inject hemin or PBS intravenously
steps.instruction: Inject hemin (Ferriprotoporphyrin IX, purchased from Frontiers Scientific) into the retro‑orbital sinus at 24 µmol kg⁻¹; inject control mice with an equal volume of PBS.

steps.title: Wait post‑injection period
steps.instruction: Maintain mice under observation for exactly 4 hours after the injection before proceeding.

steps.title: Sacrifice mice by cervical dislocation
steps.instruction: Euthanize all mice by cervical dislocation while still under isoflurane anesthesia.

steps.title: Harvest lung tissue and homogenize
steps.instruction: Excise lungs, freeze, and cut 30 µm‑thick sections. Homogenize each section in 200 µL of 1‑Thioglycerol/Homogenization Solution using the Maxwell® 16 LEV simplyRNA Tissue Kit (Promega, catalog AS1280).

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA, then evaluate concentration and integrity on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with RNA 6000 Nano Kit; accept only samples with RNA Integrity Number > 7 for downstream work.

steps.title: Prepare stranded mRNA libraries
steps.instruction: Use 1 µg of high‑quality RNA (RIN > 7) with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit (per manufacturer) to generate libraries.

substeps.instruction: Fragment poly‑A mRNA and reverse‑transcribe with random primers.
Perform second‑strand synthesis replacing dTTP with dUTP for strand specificity.
Add a single A base to cDNA ends.
Ligate Illumina adapters to the A‑tailed cDNA.

steps.title: Quantify and QC libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify each library by qPCR using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit (KapaBiosystems). Assess library size distribution with the Agilent High Sensitivity DNA LabChip kit on a Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq 500
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries at the GenomIC platform (Cochin Institute INSERM U1016) on an Illumina NextSeq 500 using 75‑bp paired‑end reads with V2 chemistry.

steps.title: Perform primary data analysis
steps.instruction: Demultiplex and quality‑control raw reads using AOZAN software (ENS, Paris) together with FastQC version 0.11.5.
